dataset: LRO Diviner Global Cumulative Product (Williams et al. 2017)
processing_notes: Team grid moon_data/moon_grid.csv, used unchanged

dataset: Mars Climate Database v6.2 surface temperature
processing_notes: Team grid mars_data/mars_grid.csv, used unchanged

dataset: LRO LOLA gridded DEM LDEM_16 (PDS)
processing_notes: Block statistics over 32 x 32 pixels; slope by central differences with a longitude stride that widens toward the poles; baseline 1.9 km

dataset: Robbins 2018 Lunar Crater Database
processing_notes: Craters counted per 2-degree cell by centre, per 100,000 km2

dataset: Lunar Prospector GRS element abundance, high-resolution 2-degree product (Prettyman et al. 2006)
processing_notes: Each 2-degree cell takes the pixel containing its centre; coarser than the grid; mare_idx scaled 0 at 8 wt% FeO to 1 at 15

dataset: LROC Lunar Pit Atlas (Wagner and Robinson)
processing_notes: Mare and highland collapse pits only; 257 impact-melt pits dropped; lavatube_idx = 0.5 mare_idx + 0.5 clip(mare pits / 2)

dataset: Geometric proxies (this project)
processing_notes: PROXIES, not measurements: illum_idx from latitude (Sun elevation); water_idx from latitude (0 below 70 deg, 1 at the pole). PSR maps and neutron hydrogen were not used

dataset: MGS MOLA MEGDR topography 16 px/deg (PDS)
processing_notes: As for the Moon DEM; pressure_pa = 610 exp(-z/11100), an estimate

dataset: Robbins and Hynek 2012 Mars crater database (USGS pygeoapi)
processing_notes: Craters 5 km and larger, counted per 2-degree cell by centre, per 100,000 km2

dataset: MGS TES nighttime thermal inertia map (Putzig and Mellon 2007)
processing_notes: Cell mean; dust_cover_idx PROXY from thermal inertia (1 at 100 or less, 0 at 350 or more)

dataset: Mars Odyssey GRS water-equivalent hydrogen, 5-degree smoothed
processing_notes: Bilinear interpolation; poleward rows with no value stay blank; water_idx = max(weh/30, latitude proxy)

dataset: USGS SIM 3292 global geologic map of Mars (Tanaka et al. 2014)
processing_notes: 44 unit codes grouped by the word in their description; rasterised at 0.1 deg and averaged to 2 deg

dataset: Lava-tube potential proxy (this project)
processing_notes: PROXY: 0.6 volcanic share + 0.4 closeness to Tharsis and Olympus skylight volcanoes. The Mars cave catalog could not be downloaded

dataset: Geometric sunlight proxy (this project)
processing_notes: PROXY: (90 - |lat|) / 90

dataset: NOAA NCEI ETOPO 2022 surface elevation, 60 arc-second
processing_notes: Land pixels only (Natural Earth mask); slope baseline 1.85 km; pressure from the standard atmosphere

dataset: GLiM Global Lithological Map 0.5-degree grid (Hartmann and Moosdorf 2012)
processing_notes: One dominant first-level class per 0.5-degree cell; each 1-degree value is the share of its four cells (steps of 25 percent)

dataset: Smithsonian Global Volcanism Program, Volcanoes of the World, Holocene volcanoes
processing_notes: Nearest-volcano distance per cell; proximity 1 within 50 km, 0 beyond 500 km

dataset: WorldClim 2.1 climate normals 1970-2000, 10 arc-minute (Fick and Hijmans 2017)
processing_notes: Annual sum (precipitation) or mean of 12 months, block-averaged to 1 degree

dataset: Natural Earth 1:50m land and admin-0, 1:10m admin-1
processing_notes: Land fraction per 1-degree cell; country by cell centre

dataset: NASA POWER climatology TS, TS_MAX, TS_MIN (surface skin temperature, 2001-2025)
processing_notes: Same method as the team's earth_grid.csv; every POWER point averaged into its cell; high and low are means of the 12 monthly values

dataset: Climate-based proxies (this project)
processing_notes: PROXIES, because NASA NEO no longer serves vegetation, aerosol or snow data: aridity = 1 - precip/1000; barren = share below 250 mm; dust = barren x wind; permafrost from air temperature thresholds

dataset: Hand-curated caves table (about 50 caves)
processing_notes: A sample, not a census; nearness means nearness to a listed cave

dataset: Hand-curated impact structures table (about 75 structures, after the Earth Impact Database)
processing_notes: Nearest listed structure; proximity 1 within 25 km, 0 beyond 250 km

dataset: Hand-curated analog sites table (about 70 sites)
processing_notes: Written by Claude and checked against Wikipedia coordinates; see validation.md

dataset: Irish sites: Athlone, Clonmacnoise, the Burren
processing_notes: Scored at their 1-degree cell

dataset: Hand-curated Moon and Mars targets
processing_notes: Artemis III region centres are approximate; see METHODS.md
